name: Aroha Renata
bio:
Aroha grew up surrounded by the aroma of her grandmother's traditional Maori baking, igniting a lifelong passion for food. After culinary school, she honed her skills in bustling Auckland restaurants before a chance encounter with a racing team owner sparked her interest in motorsport. She quickly realized the vital role catering plays in team morale and performance during long race weekends. 

Aroha joined Prema Junior with a vision to elevate the team's culinary experience, focusing on fresh, locally sourced ingredients and nutritious meals to fuel both drivers and crew. Her detail-oriented approach ensures every dietary need is met, and her creative flair brings a touch of home to the demanding racing environment. She's known for her innovative takes on classic comfort food and her ability to whip up a gourmet meal under pressure, making her an invaluable asset to the team.

What sets Aroha apart is her ability to connect with people through food. She understands the importance of a shared meal in fostering team spirit and her meticulous planning ensures that even the most stressful race weekends are punctuated by moments of culinary delight.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Aroha has a warm, friendly face and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas and food pairings
Insists on playing traditional Maori music while prepping meals
Secretly judges the quality of coffee at every race track cafe
